The plate is square, about 22–26 cm across, and it holds a small pile of cooked asparagus spears. The pile is about 12 cm long and 6 cm wide. It is roughly 1–1.5 cm thick, and I count about 10–12 thin spears, many of them trimmed pieces. At about 8–10 g per spear, that gives about 60 g. I can see a few small crumbs, possibly nuts or seasoning, which are negligible. There is no visible oil or sauce.
